reviewed_contract: D3 exact shared encoders and raw per-action scores; six numerical input keys; boolean event mask; finite shape/device/dtype checks; no path, world identity, label or environment access in model.py.
evidence_limits: This accepts only the model module and synthetic tensor tests. Public feature correctness, loss weighting, dataset completeness, real fitting, calibration and closed-loop behavior are separate gates. The pure backward check is not counted as a real training run.
